connector.name: Skew
connector.registryDescription: Authored design service: one-of-one landing pages, pitch decks, and research-grounded briefs.
connector.summary: Hosted at skew.site over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace site.skew, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token issued via Clerk OAuth2 or 64-hex agent_token from /api/agent/token (RFC 8628 device-code grant).
